proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one candidate after repeated evaluator requests for a single answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected prior non-unique responses and demanded exactly one intended answer; no explicit confirmation that HFL is correct.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer despite ambiguity, choose a candidate and clearly record that the choice is unsupported by the clues.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: For similar token_order tasks, identify whether the clues uniquely determine an order; if not, select one required candidate while marking the choice as unsupported.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues allowed both HFL and HLF, so the intended ordering was underdetermined.
